retrievalProfile.description: A high-angle studio portrait featuring a subject in reflective black leather against a geometric checkerboard floor with layered script typography.
triggerTerms: high-angle fashion portrait with script overlay
excludeWhen: modern flat vector illustrations are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait taken from a high angle, showing a person reclining on a grid-patterned floor of blue, black, and white squares. The subject wears a glossy black leather jacket and pants, creating high-specular highlights. The composition is anchored by large, expressive hand-written script and blocky numerals in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Reflective leather texture against matte floor tiles
High-angle perspective creating a diagonal body line
Hand-written white script overlapping the subject's legs
Cool-toned color palette with a single warm yellow accent
coreInvariants: Checkerboard floor pattern in blue, black, and white

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, reclining diagonally across the frame from top-left to mid-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white script in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, follows the line of the leather-clad body down to the feet, then circles back through the large foreground text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The geometric floor tiles provide structured negative space around the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark leather and the lighter floor tiles; low saturation overall with a single pop of yellow.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, steel blue, and yellow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script and casual marker-style numerals
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected script for the primary name
Varying line weight suggesting a brush or marker
Slanted, informal block numerals for the date
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated ascenders and descenders in the script
Double-quote marks styled as quick vertical slashes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid white script paired with blocky yellow marker-style numerals for a 'signed' look.

preserve: Color contrast between white and yellow text

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the fluid, hand-drawn quality of the main name.
Captures the informal, blocky nature of the date text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle studio photo of a woman in a shiny black leather suit reclining on a floor made of large blue, black, and white checkerboard tiles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, fluid white hand-written script across the lower third, overlapping the subject's legs, and add yellow marker-style numerals in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the floor a grid of blue, black, and white?
Does the leather have visible specular highlights?
Is the camera angle looking down from above?
Is the text hand-written in style?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clear geometric grid on the floor
Layered depth between text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text is legible but looks hand-drawn.
Check that the high-angle perspective is maintained.
Verify the leather texture looks authentic and reflective.
Confirm the checkerboard pattern is consistent across the floor.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-angle fashion photography + reflective leather + geometric grid floor + layered hand-drawn typography.
